verdict.rationale: Docusign documents an eSignature REST API ('Request Signatures & Automate Forms'), publishes OpenAPI specifications that generate its client SDKs, and ships an official Node.js client to send, sign, and approve documents. Developers report building production envelope-sending integrations quickly and praise the documentation's thoroughness; the embedded-signing complaints concern a different flow and do not contradict sending via the API. Document generation and data population from systems like Salesforce are documented as product features (CLM dynamic templates, auto-populate), but not explicitly as API capabilities. missing for 10: explicit API-level documentation of document generation and template field population, and independent corroboration of programmatic generation and population.
